name: Petitioner's Chamber
summary: Petitioners wait for the crown in a chamber just inside Stormwind Keep. Nobles, church dignitaries, and visiting subjects spend the time mingling, drinking, or awaiting an audience.

sections.title: A Room of Waiting and Influence
sections.body: The Petitioner's Chamber lies just to the right as you enter Stormwind Keep. Count Remington Ridgewell and Bishop DeLavey wait there for audiences with boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Between formal visits, the chamber gives nobles and clergy room to mingle, trade gossip, and quietly press their concerns. Who holds influence in the realm can often be seen in who speaks with whom.

faq.q: Where is the Petitioner's Chamber located?
faq.answer: The Petitioner's Chamber is inside Stormwind Keep, immediately to your right as you ascend the main entrance ramp.
Petitioners, court attendees, and nobles gather there, including Count Remington Ridgewell, Caledra Dawnbreeze, and Bishop DeLavey of the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Why is it also called the Hall of Petitioners?
faq.answer: The chamber takes its name from its role as a waiting room for subjects who have petitioned the crown. They wait until Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, the royal council, or the regent grants them entry to the throne room.

faq.q: What happens here during city quests?
faq.answer: Visitors come to the chamber to deliver goods or speak with nobles and clergy in the keep. Some bring refined drinks such as port to aristocrats waiting on court business.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the chamber is where domestic appeals, church affairs, and noble requests wait for the royal council's attention.
As a priest, you may find Bishop DeLavey in this antechamber, where the Holy Light's hierarchy meets the royal court.
